= Checklist contexts

== Nested checklist states

* [ ] Unchecked parent
** [x] Lowercase checked child
** [X] Uppercase checked child
** [*] Star checked child
* [x] Checked sibling

== Checklist nested under an ordered item

. Ordered parent
* [ ] Unchecked child
** [x] Checked grandchild
* [*] Checked sibling
. Ordered sibling

== Ordered list nested under a checklist item

* [x] Checklist parent
. Ordered child
.. [x] Literal lowercase marker
.. [X] Literal uppercase marker
.. [*] Literal star marker
.. [ ] Literal unchecked marker
* [ ] Checklist sibling

== Ordinary bullet nested under a checklist item

* [X] Checklist parent
** Ordinary bullet
*** [ ] Nested checklist

== Checklist-like markers in an ordered list

. [ ] Literal unchecked marker
. [x] Literal lowercase marker
. [X] Literal uppercase marker
. [*] Literal star marker
